title: SG-5.5.1 Remove duplicate SceneObject import and field in BootScene
summary: BootScene.ts compiles with one SceneObject import and one sceneObjects field
description: Context: game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts currently has `import type { SceneObject }` twice (L12 and L14) and `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = [];` twice (L22 and L23). Desired behavior: exactly one import and one field remain, with BootScene behavior unchanged. Expected result: BootScene.ts compiles without new type errors. Why: duplicate identifiers and duplicate class members are TypeScript errors and block the thin-wrapper scene work.
acceptance_criteria: Given BootScene.ts, when its source is read, then it contains exactly one `import type { SceneObject }` line.
Given BootScene.ts, when its source is read, then it contains exactly one `private sceneObjects: SceneObject[] = [];` declaration.
Given either duplicate is reintroduced, when the BootScene unit tests run, then at least one test fails.
Given the fix, when the existing BootScene tests run, then they still pass.

in_scope: Delete the duplicate import at L14 of BootScene.ts
Delete the duplicate field at L23 of BootScene.ts
Unit tests that fail when either duplicate is present
out_of_scope: Changes to engine, entities or store modules
preserve: BootScene.create, sync and objectClick forwarding behavior

technical_constraints: Unit tests only, using vitest in game/frontend
Do not change the Phaser 3.90 API usage
definition_of_done: BootScene.ts has one SceneObject import and one sceneObjects field
Unit tests assert both counts and pass
